title: Rounded
subtitle: The default
description: A rectangle with rounded corners, and the shape a quest gets when the file says nothing at all.

The corner is a quarter of the node's size, in integer arithmetic, so a node at 18 pixels cuts 4 and not 5 -- one pixel of corner, invisible in a picture and a change to every quest that already exists if it ever moved.
This is the shape that packs into a grid best, which is why it is the default.
